title: Removal of Proverb or "Peribahasa" Section from GCE "O" Level Malay Language Examinations from 2024
what_it_is: Removal of Proverb or "Peribahasa" Section from GCE "O" Level Malay Language Examinations from 2024

sections.label: Peribahasa in Malay lessons
sections.summary: Students continue learning Peribahasa in Malay lessons, developing appreciation for its values and culture through discussions, presentations and research.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Students will continue to learn Peribahasa in the Malay Language lessons.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Education (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Education)
sentences.text: Through discussions, presentations and research, students develop an appreciation for the rich values and culture encapsulated in the Peribahasa.

sections.label: Peribahasa textbooks and competitions
sections.summary: Textbooks embed Peribahasa, a committee engages community groups, and new technologies like videos and TikTok competitions are encouraged.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: Our textbooks are already embedded with Peribahasa through the various themes across different sections of the textbooks.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: In the Ministry of Education (MOE), there is a committee called the Malay Language Learning and Promotion Committee that engages community groups, including the Majlis Bahasa Melayu or the Malay Language Council, to look at events beyond schools where we provide opportunities for students to learn and express their understanding of proverbs or Peribahasa.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: We also need to look at how we can ride with the times, because children today have difficulties learning the language itself, let alone the complexities of Peribahasa.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: So, we want to make sure that they understand it and we are also encouraging them to use new technologies like the production of videos and TikTok, so that they can get interested in understanding not just the Peribahasa, but also the meaning behind it and an appreciation of the values through their own lenses.

sentences.speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
sentences.text: We encourage that and are looking at the possibilities of having TikTok competitions and video production competitions among students.
